name: Pledge Information 1
definition: Information about the pledge and pledger.

Pledger.name: Pledger
Pledger.definition: Entity that provide assets to a counterparty as a guarantee.

ThirdParty.name: Third Party
ThirdParty.definition: Third party, usually a bank, involved in the pledge.

ReturnSecuritiesIndicator.name: Return Securities Indicator
ReturnSecuritiesIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the pledger is entitled to vote, otherwise the right to vote is with the right holder.
